local.note: gross = every engine (role maestro) call in the load window / completed workflows, including background engine statements (timer-poller leader election and due-timer poll, recovery poll; lock-cleaner passes when due); net = (calls - lockCleanerCalls - backgroundRatePerSec x loadWindowSecs) / completed, the background rate itself measured without lock-cleaner calls. Lock-cleaner calls are identified by statement text and subtracted exactly; signal-janitor and retention statements must be absent from every window (validity.sweeps). TopLevel variants exclude statements nested in others (track=all, e.g. foreign-key trigger queries).
